subject: Web Development
title: Content Moderation at Scale
description: A 60-second lesson on Content Moderation at Scale.

hook.text: Billions of posts are published daily. No company can review them all with human moderators.

buildup.text: AI moderation catches most harmful content but struggles with context, sarcasm, and culture.

discovery.text: Over-moderation silences legitimate speech. Under-moderation lets harm spread.

twist.text: Content moderators face severe mental health consequences from exposure to extreme content.

climax.text: Moderation at web scale is one of the hardest unsolved problems in technology and society.

punchline.text: Moderation at scale has no good solution yet.

quiz.question: Why is AI moderation imperfect?
options: It struggles with context and sarcasm
It costs too much to run
